outputs.explanation: Spatial deconvolution plots show heatmap-style values overlaid on tissue spots; this is not a summary bar/mean plot type requiring individual data point overlay.
Box plots are shown with individual data points (jittered dots) overlaid, in addition to the distribution statistics (median, quartiles, min/max).
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
The bar graph shows log2 fold change values per gene from DEG analysis without any individual data points or replicate values overlaid on the bars.
Panel E consists of representative H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
